reports.notes: Born-digital fillable form, typed figures printed with a leading '$' (dropped per spec). The Office field reads 'County Recorder', matching index.csv. Page numbering is the filer's '1 of 4' / '4 of 4'.

expenditures.note: The candidate repaying himself, dated the same day as the report (22 Apr 2024). Transcribed as printed. Note the filer calls his own Schedule A entries 'Personal Loans' HERE while entering them as contributions THERE — recorded, not adjudicated; the contribution side is gated by the page's own arithmetic (§B3), not by this wording.

contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' ($410.00) on the p4 Summary Page, equal to Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' ($ 410.00) AND its 'Total Contributions Received / Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report' ($ 410.00)
contributions.detail: 4 Schedule A rows sum to 100 + 50 + 150 + 110 = 410.00 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal = the schedule's printed grand total = the promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box B. All three printed anchors agree. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' also prints $410.00 (single report of the cycle: period = year to date) and is NOT summed as an increment. LOAN LADDER (§B3): three of the four rows are the candidate's OWN money (donor 'Garrett Mast'), and Schedule B row 7 is a 157.89 'Repayment of Personal Loans' to himself; the self-money is nonetheless booked on Schedule A and is inside the printed 410.00 subtotal that Box B repeats, with Box A = $0.00 leaving no beginning-balance slot — so the page books them AS contribution rows and they are published as such. The full ladder closes: F = A + B = 0 + 410 = 410.00, close = F - D = 410 - 410 = $0.00, exactly as printed.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' ($410.00) on the p4 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' ($ 410.00) AND its 'Total Expenditures Made / Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report' ($ 410.00)
expenditures.detail: 7 Schedule B rows sum to 96.69 + 22.58 + 1.07 + 6.19 + 15.99 + 109.59 + 157.89 = 410.00 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed grand total = the promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box D. Box E YTD also prints $410.00 and is never summed as an increment. The coincidence that contributions and expenditures are BOTH 410.00 is the filer's own doing — he zeroed the account by repaying himself 157.89 on the report date, which is what makes the close box $0.00; the two sides were reconciled independently against their own schedules' footers, never against each other.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only, and it is the only convention this filing supports: the v. 12.23 Schedule A prints FOUR columns with NO in-kind checkbox and no in-kind line anywhere, and no row carries an in-kind annotation. Both conventions therefore yield the same sums (410.00 / 410.00) and both close. Tested per §G1, not inherited from the previous filing.
itemized.escalation_note: Six 900 dpi tight --value crops, all geometry proofs (first row, last row, one-band-past control on each schedule page). No figure was in dispute: this is a born-digital fillable form, so every figure is machine type and the crops render crisp anti-aliased vector text.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE identity: 'Garrett Mast', Office box prints 'County Recorder', report type ticked '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination', amendment ticked 'No', Date of Report '22 April 2024'. index.csv's channel label 'Garrett  Mast' / 'County Recorder' agrees with the page face on both. FORM: modern_boxAF, footer 'v. 12.23' on all four pages, masthead 'Aaron Davidson / Clerk'. ⚠ NEW SOURCE PROPERTY — the v. 12.23 blank exists in TWO PRINT RENDERINGS: this filing is the FULL-COLOUR original (navy 'Candidate Financial Disclosure' rule, navy/red UTAH COUNTY CLERK mark, navy bullet points) and is born-digital clean, whereas 5f688615 in the same chunk is a GREYSCALE photocopy-style rendering of the same v. 12.23 blank. The two differ measurably in grid geometry (column rules 6.0/19.7/51.2/80.7/94.4 here vs 7.2/20.5/50.9/79.4/92.7 there; pitch 4.55 vs 4.45), so a frame must never be carried between them. Everything else matches ADDENDUM M2 exactly: 4 pages cover / Schedule A / Schedule B / SUMMARY LAST (each located by its own printed heading); five report types with 'Convention' and 'End-of-Year' absent and '30 Days after the Primary Election' present; Schedule A four columns Date / Name of Contributor / Address and Zip Code / Amount with NO city-state column and NO in-kind checkbox; Schedule B with a real Purpose column; 15-row boxed grids each printing its own two footers; Summary A / B-C / D-E / F + an UNLETTERED close box. NO CHECKLIST DECOY is bound (4 pages, all accounted for). FOLIATION IS COMPLETE AND CONSISTENT here — 'Page 1 of 4' ... '4 of 4' — positive evidence that no sheet is missing (the §D6/§H6 fax-counter logic applied to the Page box). DATE ANOMALY, recorded not adjudicated: the cover's signature 'Date' box is EMPTY (the signature itself is blacked out by the county) while 'Date of Report' prints 22 April 2024 — so the filing carries no signature date. AMOUNT STYLE: this filer writes contributions with a leading '$' and NO CENTS ('$100', '$50', '$150', '$110') but expenditures with '$' and full cents; the currency symbol is dropped and the digits kept exactly as printed. Both sides close EXACTLY on the promoted per-period figures, and all three printed anchors per side agree.
